purpose: Inert historical source preservation; not feature adoption, a runnable standalone checkout, or current acceptance evidence.
source: Existing local Git objects; no retrieval/download.
activation: None. Every original file has a .reference suffix and mode 100644. No active source/build/CI/test registry is changed; historical workflow YAML is nested below research/legacy only. Explicitly decoding or running these references requires separate review/authority.

securityScan.scope: All copied UTF-8 text checked before write for NUL/binary, private-key markers, common token/JWT and signed-URL values. Heuristic, not a guarantee. No sensitive-pattern hits, no redactions.
